title: The Science of GLP-1: How These Medications Affect Your Body

authorship.recommended_normalized_author: Healthy Weight Literacy Foundation Editorial Team

primary_question: How do GLP-1 receptor agonist medications work biologically, and how do they differ from older weight-management drugs?
reader_intent: Understand the physiological mechanism of GLP-1 medications well enough to have an informed conversation with a provider.
desired_reader_outcome: Reader understands the natural GLP-1 hormone, the gut-brain axis, glucose-dependent insulin secretion, delayed gastric emptying, and why this differs from older appetite-suppressant/fat-blocker drugs.

claims.proposition: Natural GLP-1 is broken down by the enzyme DPP-4 within just two to three minutes.
claims.recommended_action: Specific, checkable pharmacokinetic figure with zero citation. Verify the exact native GLP-1 half-life against a primary pharmacology source (e.g., a Drucker or Holst GLP-1 physiology review) before restating.

claims.proposition: GLP-1 insulin secretion is glucose-dependent, reducing hypoglycemia risk relative to some other diabetes medications when used alone.
claims.recommended_action: Standard, well-established endocrine pharmacology, but zero citation anywhere in the article. Cite a primary GLP-1 mechanism review.

claims.proposition: GLP-1 receptor agonists slow gastric emptying, contributing to fullness and early digestive side effects.
claims.recommended_action: Well-established mechanism; needs a citation, not a correction.

internal_link_recommendations.reason: After understanding the mechanism, a reader evaluating options should understand compounded-vs-FDA-approved risk.
Mechanism understanding naturally leads into preparing provider questions.

disposition_reason: Accurate, appropriately hedged, individual-variation-aware mechanism education, but it has zero cited sources for a medication-class physiology article, including one specific, checkable pharmacokinetic number (DPP-4 half-life) stated without support.
required_research: Cite a primary GLP-1 physiology review for the mechanism claims and independently verify the exact 2-3 minute DPP-4 degradation half-life figure.
recommended_rewrite_scope: Add a Sources section citing primary GLP-1 pharmacology literature.
Attach the specific half-life claim to its source or qualify it as approximate if the exact source figure differs.
safety_language_findings: Appropriately frames effects as varying by individual; does not promise outcomes.
No dosing instructions given (correctly deferred to providers).
